title: cynorkis citrina
intro: Cynorkis citrina, commonly known as the Yellow Bee Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Madagascar. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Cynorkis citrina include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, contributing to its overall healing potential. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
